subject: Re: Compliance add-ons - evidence milestones & credit split
messages:
From: Sara Miller <sara.miller@compliantcare.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@compliantcare.com
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons - evidence milestones & credit split

Jonas,

Thanks for the breakdown in the call yesterday. Procurement asked for a written proposal so we can route internally. Two specific asks: 1) we want the HSM/KMS cost treated as a_credits_ against recurring invoices rather than an up-front capital line item; 2) we need clarity on what evidence (attestations, SOC snippets, auditlog exports) we must deliver to unlock credits.

Our target: pilot in April, roll to production by July. Would Redwood consider amortizing an implementation/attestation fee over the first 12 months of committed usage?

Thanks,
Sara Miller
Head of IT Procurement
CompliantCare

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@compliantcare.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons - evidence milestones & credit split

Sara — appreciate the clear asks. Below is a concise counterproposal we think balances procurement needs and Redwood's cost model:

Summary counterproposal (high level):
- HSM/KMS: price as two parts — one-time provisioning fee (covers HSM seat licensing & HSM key setup) + ongoing per-GB egress/throughput charge.
- Crediting: we will convert 50% of the provisioning fee into account credits applied against monthly hosted inference charges, amortized over 12 months, contingent on evidence milestones. The remaining 50% remains an implementation charge due at signature.
- Evidence milestones (to unlock incremental credits):
  1) Onboarding evidence (week 0): signed SOW + onprem/VPC network confirmation -> unlock 20% of the credits.
  2) Attestation delivery (week 6): HSM attestation report + KMS key policy document -> unlock further 40% of the credits.
  3) Production enablement (go-live): auditlog export sample + runbook access -> unlock final 40% of the credits.

We can make two adjustments for EU customers: shift amortization to 18 months (to reduce monthly impact on the customer) OR increase the up-front credit conversion from 50% to 60% if procurement accepts a 30% smaller immediate cash payment.

Action items for CompliantCare: confirm which option you prefer (12mo amortize with 50% conversion OR 18mo with 60% conversion) and confirm the go-live window. If you prefer, we can present the numbers as a short addendum to the SOW.

I'll let Dev confirm the feasibility/timing for the attestation deliverables below.

— Jonas Weber
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sara Miller <sara.miller@compliantcare.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: CompliantCare Procurement <procurement@compliantcare.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 08:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons - evidence milestones & credit split

Jonas — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement's feedback: they'd prefer no large up-front cash payment at all if we can stretch credits over 24 months. Their rationale: preserving cash flow during pilot. Is Redwood willing to amortize across 24 months with the same milestone unlocking? They'd accept a slightly higher nominal provisioning fee if it avoided payment at signature.

To move this quickly, procurement asked that we include an itemized schedule showing monthly charge delta under your proposal vs a 24mo amortization. Can you provide that?

Best,
Sara

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@compliantcare.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons - evidence milestones & credit split

Sara — appreciate procurement's position. Quick note from pricing: 24-month amortization materially increases total contract exposure and our internal credit risk; we can do it but need a small trade: 1) extend committed usage threshold by +15% (e.g., commit to 15% higher monthly tokens/throughput than pilot estimate) OR 2) increase the provisioning fee by 12% and keep credits at 60% conversion. Either trade keeps Redwood whole.

I'll attach a simple spreadsheet that models the three options (12mo/50%, 18mo/60%, 24mo + concession) and the monthly P&L impact. If helpful, happy to hop on a 20-min call with procurement.

— Tessa Morgan
Director, Pricing & Packaging
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_checklist.xlsx (pricing model tab included)

---

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@compliantcare.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons - evidence milestones & credit split

Folks — quick technical confirmation on the milestones: the attestation report (milestone #2) is standard and we can deliver a vendor attestation within 6 weeks of environment readiness. Auditlog export samples (milestone #3) require that CompliantCare enables the audit collection agent in staging and gives our SRE access for a 48-hour window to pull sample exports — we documented the exact steps in the attached SOW.

Important note: HSM seats for the EU region have a 30–45 day lead time for provisioning with our hardware partner. If procurement wants a 24-month amort window to avoid up-front payment, we need signed SOW no later than 2028-03-20 to avoid a month+ delay on the pilot start.

— Dev Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: CompliantCare_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, network checklist, timeline)

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@compliantcare.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons - evidence milestones & credit split

Sara / Procurement — Naomi here from Commercial Ops. We've reviewed internally and can approve the following final concession to keep the timeline intact:

Final approved offer (Redwood):
- Provisioning fee will be converted to credits at 60% upon signature. Remaining 40% due at signature.
- Amortization of credits will occur over 18 months (EU-specific standard).
- If CompliantCare requires 24 months amortization, we will accept it only if procurement also agrees to either (a) a 15% higher committed usage floor for the first 12 months OR (b) an increased provisioning fee (12% uplift) to cover amortization risk.
- Evidence milestone schedule remains as Jonas proposed. Our SRE will coordinate with CompliantCare for the 48-hour auditlog export window.

Please confirm which path you accept so T&Cs and a short addendum can be issued. Once confirmed, I will send a DocuSign link for the SOW + addendum (HubSpot deal updated: CC-2028-049).

Thanks — Naomi Feldman
Head, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

CompliantCare next steps (from procurement):
- Confirm preferred amortization choice (18mo with 60% conversion accepted, or 24mo + trade).
- Sign SOW and return by 2028-03-20 to preserve pilot start window.

Attachment references: CompliantCare_SOW_v1.pdf; evidence_checklist.xlsx
